column3: It's quiet.\nWhere is everyone?{end_wait}
That tree...\nIt was a person.{end_wait}
The whole village...\nThey're all trees.{end_wait}
Look at the clothes.\nThese were people.{end_wait}
{text_effect:4}My mind!!!\nSomeone{pause_20_skippable} is attacking my{em_dash}{end_wait}
We have to get out!{end_wait}
No... It's happening\nto us, too!\nWe're turning into trees!{end_wait}
Our Psynergy\nprotected us.{end_wait}
What do you mean?{end_wait}
You're lying, {actor_name:1}!{end_wait}
I practiced until\nmy head ached.{end_wait}
Maybe it's easy\nfor you. Not for me.{end_wait}
No. Psynergy takes focus.\nIt doesn't just happen.{end_wait}
Maybe some powers\nwork on their own.{end_wait}
When we're afraid?{end_wait}
Like finding strength\nwhen you're in danger.{page_break}But we can't do it\non command.{end_wait}
Could we use this power\nat will, {actor_name:1}?{end_now}
Then let's find out.{end_wait}
Are you even\nlistening to me?{end_wait}
Hroom... They're unharmed.\nHow did they resist?{end_wait}
We'll leave it to you,\n{actor_name:1}. Help them.{end_wait}
They'll stay like\nthis forever?{end_now}
We can't leave\nthem here like this.{end_wait}
How do we save\nTret and the village?{end_wait}
I don't know.\nNot yet.{end_wait}
{actor_name:3}, please.\nWe need your help.{end_wait}
Promise you'll help\nthe people of Kolima.{end_wait}
I thought you'd leave,\n{actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
How can we save\nTret and Kolima?{end_wait}
I wish I knew.{end_wait}
Then we keep looking.\nThere has to be a way.{end_wait}
Then let's go.{end_wait}
HROOOM! He hears you.\nI won't let him answer.{end_wait}
Wait! If Tret dies,\nwhat happens to\nthe villagers?{end_wait}
We still need him,\n{actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, remember.{page_break}Kolima still needs us.{end_wait}
I did that to Kolima?\nThose were people...{end_wait}
Tret's too weak\nto undo the curse.{end_wait}
Then we help him.{page_break}The villagers are\nstill waiting.{end_wait}
How? He's fading right\nin front of us.{end_wait}
Laurel might know.\nLet's ask her.{end_wait}
Try the water!{end_wait}
It may restore\nhis strength.{end_wait}
Hroom... I can feel\nthe sap rising again.{end_wait}
I frightened you, Laurel.\nAnd I hurt so many others.{end_wait}
You saved my life,\nbut you still need my help.\nDon't you?{end_now}
{actor_name:1}, the villagers!\nAsk Tret to help!{end_wait}
Tret can help them\nnow. Ask him!{end_wait}
He has to undo\nwhat he did.{end_wait}
Tret, they're still\ntrapped. Can you\nfree them?{end_wait}
I never had\nthis power before.{end_wait}
It came when stones\nfell from the sky.{end_wait}
Stones from the sky...\nPsynergy Stones?{end_now}
Could the stones\nreally do this?{end_wait}
I don't want to believe\nit, either.{end_wait}
Then those strange stones\nfell into my branches.{end_wait}
After that, my anger\nwas all I could hear.{end_wait}
The stones fell\nwhile I was grieving.\nI welcomed their power.{end_wait}
The stones made\nyour anger stronger.{page_break}But you still chose\nwhat you did.{end_wait}
Yes. And I must\nmake it right.{end_wait}
Only the elder trees\nwere touched by them.{end_wait}
Other trees too?{end_wait}
Then this may be\nhappening elsewhere.{end_wait}
You met strange\nbeasts on the road.{end_wait}
They may once have\nbeen ordinary animals.{end_wait}
They were alive.{page_break}The stones changed\nthem somehow.{end_wait}
Laurel, did the stones\nchange you too?{end_wait}
The stones changed me.\nThey didn't decide\nwhat I would do.{end_wait}
Laurel? What is it?{end_wait}
Wait. You'll see.{end_wait}
What did you find, Laurel?{end_wait}
The animals have changed.{page_break}And south of the river...{end_wait}
Another forest\nhas changed there.{end_wait}
That forest is\ndangerous.{page_break}Please be careful\nif you go there.{end_wait}
Then stay here.\nThere's no shame in it.{end_wait}
May the road ahead be\nkinder than this forest.{end_wait}
We've grown stronger,\n{actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
You resisted his curse.\nI felt it from here.{end_wait}
And yet you came closer.\nWhy risk your lives?{end_wait}
Tret is fading.\nI don't know how much\ntime he has left.{end_wait}
When Tret dies,\nthese woods will follow.{page_break}Leave while you can.{end_wait}
